home.alt: The Home screen with cards for people, updates, repairs and engines
home.caption: Your Home screen: who is here and what needs attention.

chat-empty.alt: An empty chat that says How can I help you today

people.alt: The Family page with a card each for Sage, Marlow and Nova

memory.alt: The Memories tab on Sage's profile with one memory and a Clear all button

notifications.alt: The Notifications settings with alert switches, quiet hours and a Telegram card
notifications.caption: Notification settings: alerts, quiet hours and Telegram.

repairs.alt: The Repairs list with a warning that says Restart the search helper in the Fix column

roles-users.alt: The Users list showing an owner, a teen and a child, with an Add someone form
roles-users.caption: Pick a role in Add someone. It decides what the person can do.

updates.alt: The Updates table with one row for MaiPai Home
updates.caption: The Updates table: what is installed and what is available.

fit-check.alt: The AI models page saying Qwen3 8B Instruct runs well on this computer
fit-check.caption: The AI models page says whether a model fits this computer.

sign-in-picker.alt: The sign-in screen with a circle for Sage, Marlow and Nova

sign-in-pin.alt: The PIN screen for Sage with four boxes and a Use a password instead link
sign-in-pin.caption: Type your four digits, or tap Use a password instead.

sign-in-wrong-pin.alt: The PIN screen after a wrong PIN, showing the hint

settings-ease.alt: The Appearance settings with the Ease of use card and Comfort style set to Standard

settings-network.alt: The Network and access settings with the Reach Home from anywhere steps

settings-engines.alt: The Engines and AI settings listing a model choice for each role
settings-engines.caption: Engines and AI: one model choice for each job.

backups.alt: The Backups list with dates and sizes and a Back up now button
backups.caption: Backups lists each copy with its date and size.

main-menu-desktop.alt: The Home page on a computer with the icon rail on the left
main-menu-desktop.caption: On a computer, the menu is a column of icons on the left.

main-menu-phone.alt: The Home page on a phone with the icon rail on the left
main-menu-phone.caption: On a phone, the same menu stays at the side.

setup-wizard.alt: The first setup step, Your computers, with a Set up my Home button
setup-wizard.caption: Setup starts with Your computers.
